Title: Add routing://decisions MCP resource (recent routing decision log)
Description: Expose the routing engine's RoutingDecision records as a readable MCP resource. Each decision includes: taskId, selected node+model, all candidate scores, policy applied, fallback chain traversed, decision duration. Currently only visible in Serilog logs and Blazor dashboard. As a resource, external clients can replay recent decisions and debug why tasks landed where they did. Implement as a circular buffer of last N=100 decisions.
